title: Use of the Term Natural on Food Labeling
summary: FDA notice requesting comment on defining natural, describing its informal policy that excludes farming methods.

assertions.quote: the FDA has not engaged in rulemaking to establish a formal definition for the term
nothing artificial or synthetic (including all color additives regardless of source) has been included in, or has been added to, a food

verdicts.note: The FDA's longstanding policy defines natural only as having no added artificial or synthetic ingredients and does not cover production methods.

FDA's longstanding policy is that 'natural' means nothing artificial or synthetic, color additives included, was added that would not normally be in the food; it was not meant to cover production methods such as pesticides, processing methods, or health benefits.
